status: First native approximate shape study; awaiting visual acceptance
coordinateFrame: Metres, x lateral, y upward from rail, z rearward from the first leading axle. Body silhouette measurements remain provisional despite metre units.
bufferSharing: Single-material parts may share the generated position/normal/UV arrays; each part has its own index buffer. Do not sum per-part vertex counts as unique vertices.

mainShell.geometry: Six longitudinal sections. Monotone cubic Hermite interpolation of width, upper height and shoulder height. Elliptic upper cross section, separate side-skirt surfaces with circular driving-wheel clearance lower boundaries.
mainShell.controlMeaning: Six normalized longitudinal locations, six width factors, six top-height factors, six shoulder heights. These are newly authored approximation controls, not a source point table.
mainShell.cab: Three open rectangular side-window regions per side, recessed window reveals, two front windscreen holes, central rear access opening, elliptical roof and end closures.
mainShell.sampling: 128 longitudinal intervals plus section/cutout transition sites;48 cross-section intervals. Resolution is separate from shape controls.
mainShell.normals: Analytic cross product of parametric surface derivatives; planar cap/window-reveal normals. UV is generated from the same parameter domain.
mainShell.knownApproximationLimits: Cab windows are deliberately simplified rectangles; source micro-bevels, trim, vents, livery, lights, rivets, interior and mechanical gear are not reconstructed. The main shell is primarily a surface skin, not an engineered finite-thickness structural shell. No source-distance error bound or visual-fidelity acceptance has been established.

rearShell.geometry: Nine editable shape/location parameters generate24 ruled planar patches: exterior/interior walls, upper bevel, top rim and lower wall rim. Top and underside are open.

verifiedReferenceParameters.source: Shared src/dimensions.mjs; contemporary1935 LNER-provided Silver Link drawing and independent museum width reference are documented in a4-prototype-dimensions-evidence.json.

tests.checks: Finite typed arrays, valid indices, nonzero triangles, unit normals, winding, explicit window/wheel-clearance rays, dimension edits, normal updates, parameter rejection. Test results do not prove source fidelity or complete mechanical reconstruction.

productionOldAssets: No changes to08 or frozen09/10 research assets by this implementation.
